scanNote: 21-mashqda sakkiz ravishdan IKKITASI kitobdagi namunada berilgan (suddenly, sleepily), IKKITASI ma'no jihatdan bir xil variantga majbur ('closed the door TIGHTLY', 'shouted DESPERATELY'). Qolgan TO'RTTASI (c, d, g, h) faqat audiodan aniq bilinadi — bu yerda hikoya mantig'iga eng mos variant berildi va har bir izohda asosi ko'rsatildi.
audioRequiredUz: 18-mashq — favqulodda xizmat dialogi. 20-mashq — /ʌ/ va /ɒ/ tovushlari. 21-mashq — hikoyani tinglab ravishlarni qo'yish.

sections.title: Communication — Reporting Emergencies
sections.titleUz: Muloqot — Favqulodda hodisa haqida xabar berish

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue. Then, in pairs, read the dialogue aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang. So'ng juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  O: Emergency services ... Which service do you require,
     please?
  A: POLICE, please.
  B: HILL STREET POLICE STATION ... Can I help you?
  A: I want to report A BREAK-IN at my house. Please come
     quickly!
  B: Could you give me your address and telephone number,
     please?
  A: Yes — it's 5, BOND ROAD and my telephone number is
     9834758.
  B: And your name, please?
  A: JACK ROSS.
  B: Thank you, MR ROSS. There's A POLICE CAR on the way now.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O: Favqulodda xizmatlar... Qaysi xizmat kerak?
  A: Militsiya, iltimos.
  B: Hill Street militsiya bo'limi... Yordam bera olamanmi?
  A: Uyimga o'g'rilik bo'lgani haqida xabar bermoqchiman.
     Iltimos, tezroq keling!
  B: Manzilingiz va telefon raqamingizni ayta olasizmi?
  A: Ha — 5, Bond Road, telefon raqamim 9834758.
  B: Ismingiz-chi?
  A: Jek Ross.
  B: Rahmat, janob Ross. Hozir militsiya mashinasi
     yo'lda.


DIALOG TUZILISHI (5 bosqich):
  1) Operator QAYSI XIZMAT kerakligini so'raydi
  2) Chaqiruvchi xizmatni aytadi
  3) Chaqiruvchi MUAMMONI aytadi
  4) Operator MANZIL va TELEFON so'raydi
  5) Operator ISM so'raydi va yordam yuborilganini aytadi

UCH FAVQULODDA XIZMAT:
  POLICE       — militsiya
  FIRE BRIGADE — o't o'chirish xizmati
  AMBULANCE    — tez yordam

Britaniyada favqulodda raqam: 999
AQShda: 911
O'zbekistonda: 101, 102, 103

MUHIM IBORALAR:
  Which service do you require?
     = Qaysi xizmat kerak?
  I want to report ...
     = ...haqida xabar bermoqchiman.
  Please come quickly!
     = Iltimos, tezroq keling!
  Could you give me your address, please?
     = Manzilingizni ayta olasizmi?
  There's a ... on the way now.
     = Hozir ... yo'lda.

DIQQAT — 'COULD YOU ...?':
  'Can you ...?' dan MULOYIMROQ.
Rasmiy suhbatda 'could' ishlatiladi.

DIQQAT — TELEFON RAQAMI O'QILISHI:
  9834758 → 'nine eight three four seven five eight'
  Raqamlar BITTALAB o'qiladi.
  '0' → 'oh' yoki 'zero' deb o'qiladi.
  Ikki bir xil raqam ketma-ket bo'lsa: '77' → 'double seven'.

DIQQAT — MANZIL:
  '5, Bond Road' — avval UY RAQAMI, keyin KO'ChA nomi.
  O'zbekchada teskari: Bond ko'chasi, 5-uy.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  emergency services = favqulodda xizmatlar
  to require   = talab qilmoq, kerak bo'lmoq
  to report    = xabar bermoq
  a break-in   = o'g'rilik (uyga bostirib kirish)
  on the way   = yo'lda

points.en: Emergency services ... Which service do you require, please?
points.noteUz:
Operatorning BIRINCHI savoli.
'to require' = kerak bo'lmoq (rasmiy so'z).
Uch xizmatdan birini tanlaysiz.

Qisqa javob — faqat xizmat nomi.
Boshqa variantlar: Fire brigade, please. / Ambulance, please.

points.en: Hill Street Police Station ... Can I help you?
points.uz: Hill Street militsiya bo'limi... Yordam bera olamanmi?
points.noteUz:
Bo'lim o'z nomini aytadi.
'Can I help you?' — Grammar 41-betdagi standart ibora.

points.en: I want to report a break-in at my house. Please come quickly!
points.uz: Uyimga o'g'rilik bo'lgani haqida xabar bermoqchiman. Iltimos, tezroq keling!
points.noteUz:
'I want to report ...' — muammoni bildirish qolipi.
'a break-in' = o'g'rilik (break in = bostirib kirmoq).
'quickly' — RAVISH (79-bet).

points.en: Could you give me your address and telephone number, please?
points.uz: Manzilingiz va telefon raqamingizni ayta olasizmi?
points.noteUz:
'COULD you ...?' — 'Can you' dan MULOYIMROQ.
Rasmiy suhbatda ishlatiladi.

points.en: Yes — it's 5, Bond Road and my telephone number is 9834758.
points.noteUz:
Manzilda avval UY RAQAMI, keyin KO'ChA nomi.
Telefon raqami BITTALAB o'qiladi:
'nine eight three four seven five eight'.

points.en: Thank you, Mr Ross. There's a police car on the way now.
points.uz: Rahmat, janob Ross. Hozir militsiya mashinasi yo'lda.
points.noteUz:
'Mr' + FAMILIYA (ism emas).
'on the way' = yo'lda, kelayotgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, use the prompts below and your own name, address and telephone number to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan va o'z ismingiz, manzilingiz va telefon raqamingizdan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI KO'RSATMA TO'PLAMI:

  1-QUTI (o't o'chirish):
     fire brigade
     Hill Street Fire Station
     a fire
     a fire engine

  2-QUTI (tez yordam):
     ambulance
     Upton Hospital
     an accident
     an ambulance

QALIN YOZILGAN SO'ZLARNI ALMAShTIRASIZ:
  Police            → fire brigade / ambulance
  Police Station    → Fire Station / Hospital
  a break-in        → a fire / an accident
  a police car      → a fire engine / an ambulance

ISM, MANZIL va TELEFON — O'ZINGIZNIKI.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a fire brigade = o't o'chirish xizmati
  a fire engine  = o't o'chirish mashinasi
  an ambulance   = tez yordam mashinasi
  an accident    = baxtsiz hodisa
  a hospital     = kasalxona

items.prompt: 1-QUTI — fire brigade / Hill Street Fire Station / a fire / a fire engine
items.question: Emergency services ... Which service do you require, please? — Fire brigade, please. — Hill Street Fire Station ... Can I help you?
items.answer: I want to report a fire at my house. Please come quickly! — Could you give me your address and telephone number, please? — Yes — it's 5, Bond Road and my telephone number is 9834758. — And your name, please? — Jack Ross. — Thank you, Mr Ross. There's a fire engine on the way now.
items.whyUz:
Qalin so'zlar almashtirildi:
  Police → FIRE BRIGADE
  Police Station → FIRE STATION
  a break-in → A FIRE
  a police car → A FIRE ENGINE
Qolgan qolip O'ZGARMAYDI.

items.prompt: 2-QUTI — ambulance / Upton Hospital / an accident / an ambulance
items.question: Emergency services ... Which service do you require, please? — Ambulance, please. — Upton Hospital ... Can I help you?
items.answer: I want to report an accident at my house. Please come quickly! — Could you give me your address and telephone number, please? — Yes — it's 5, Bond Road and my telephone number is 9834758. — And your name, please? — Jack Ross. — Thank you, Mr Ross. There's an ambulance on the way now.
items.whyUz:
Qalin so'zlar almashtirildi:
  Police → AMBULANCE
  Police Station → UPTON HOSPITAL
  a break-in → AN ACCIDENT
  a police car → AN AMBULANCE
DIQQAT: 'AN accident', 'AN ambulance' — unli tovush → AN.

items.question: Emergency services ... Which service do you require, please? — Fire brigade, please.
items.answer: I want to report a fire at my house. Please come quickly! — Could you give me your address and telephone number, please? — Yes — it's 12, Amir Temur Street and my telephone number is 2345678. — And your name, please? — Aziz Karimov. — Thank you, Mr Karimov. There's a fire engine on the way now.
items.whyUz:
Ism, manzil va telefon O'ZINGIZNIKI bo'ladi.
DIQQAT: manzilda avval UY RAQAMI keladi.
Telefon raqami BITTALAB o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko olgan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (14 ta):
  suddenly, roared, desperately, beeped the horn, scary,
  thanked, proud, mended, hold on, tightly, alive,
  shocked, for a while, on his way home

Hammasi 11-unitning ikki hikoyasidan olingan:
  76-77-bet — safari parkdagi voqea
  80-bet     — Hans Brinker hikoyasi

O'YIN QOIDASI:
  • ikki jamoaga bo'linasiz
  • navbat bilan ro'yxatdan bittasini tanlaysiz
  • u bilan TO'G'RI gap tuzasiz → 1 ochko
  • eng ko'p ochko — g'olib

DIQQAT — RAVIShLAR:
  suddenly, desperately, tightly — bular RAVISH,
  fe'lni aniqlaydi (79-betdagi qoida).

DIQQAT — SIFATLAR:
  scary, proud, alive, shocked — bular SIFAT,
  otni yoki egani aniqlaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: Suddenly, smoke began to come out of the engine.

modelSentences.uz: "Tiriklayin yonamiz!" — deb jon holatda qichqirdi Kler.

modelSentences.sentence: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
modelSentences.uz: U signal chaldi va yordam so'rab qichqirdi.

modelSentences.sentence: They're beautiful, but very scary animals.
modelSentences.uz: Ular go'zal, lekin juda qo'rqinchli hayvonlar.

modelSentences.sentence: They thanked the park ranger for his help.
modelSentences.uz: Ular park qo'riqchisiga yordami uchun rahmat aytishdi.

modelSentences.sentence: Everyone was very proud of that brave little boy.

modelSentences.sentence: The people quickly mended the hole in the dike.
"Hold on, we'll get you out!" the park ranger shouted.
modelSentences.uz: "Chidang, sizni chiqarib olamiz!" — deb qichqirdi park qo'riqchisi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TOVUSH:

  /ʌ/ — qisqa 'a' tovushi.
        Og'iz biroz ochiq, til o'rtada.
        O'zbekchadagi 'A' ga yaqin, lekin qisqaroq.
        Odatda 'U' harfi bilan yoziladi:
           cut, sun, but, run, shut
        Ba'zan 'O' bilan ham:
           come, some, love, month

  /ɒ/ — qisqa 'o' tovushi.
        Lablar dumaloq, og'iz kengroq ochiq.
        O'zbekchadagi 'O' ga yaqin.
        Odatda 'O' harfi bilan yoziladi:
           hot, stop, shot, wrong, dog

TO'RT SO'Z BU MASHQDA:
  wrong  /rɒŋ/   → /ɒ/    (noto'g'ri)
  rung   /rʌŋ/   → /ʌ/    ('ring' ning 3-shakli)
  shut   /ʃʌt/   → /ʌ/    (yopmoq)
  shot   /ʃɒt/   → /ɒ/    ('shoot' ning o'tgan shakli)

DIQQAT — IKKI ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK:
  wrong /rɒŋ/  ↔  rung /rʌŋ/
  shot  /ʃɒt/  ↔  shut /ʃʌt/

  Faqat BITTA unli tovush farq qiladi,
  lekin ma'no BUTUNLAY boshqa.

DIQQAT — 'WRONG' YOZILIShI:
  Boshidagi 'W' O'QILMAYDI → /rɒŋ/.
  Shunga o'xshash: write /raɪt/, wrap /ræp/.

QO'ShIMChA JUFTLIKLAR (mashq uchun):
  cut /kʌt/    ↔  cot /kɒt/
  much /mʌtʃ/  ↔  watch /wɒtʃ/
  sun /sʌn/    ↔  son /sʌn/  (IKKALASI ham /ʌ/!)

items.whyUz:
/rɒŋ/ — qisqa 'o' tovushi → /ɒ/.
DIQQAT: boshidagi 'W' O'QILMAYDI.
'wrong' = noto'g'ri.

/rʌŋ/ — qisqa 'a' tovushi → /ʌ/.
'rung' — 'ring' fe'lining uchinchi shakli
(ring — rang — rung).
'wrong' bilan SOLISHTIRING: faqat unli farq qiladi.

/ʃʌt/ → /ʌ/.
'to shut' = yopmoq (= to close).
shut → SHUT (shakli O'ZGARMAYDI).

/ʃɒt/ → /ɒ/.
'shot' — 'shoot' (otmoq) fe'lining o'tgan shakli.
'shut' bilan SOLISHTIRING: faqat unli farq qiladi,
lekin ma'no butunlay boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the story, then try to fill in the gaps with adverbs from the list. Listen again and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tinglang, so'ng bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi ravishlar bilan to'ldirishga harakat qiling. Yana tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ravish, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  desperately, immediately, suddenly, carefully,
  quickly, tightly, sleepily, nervously

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (a va b bandlarni beradi):
  'Tony SUDDENLY heard noises. First, he went SLEEPILY to
   the window. Next, ...'


DIQQAT — QAYSI JAVOB QANChALIK ANIQ:

  ANIQ BILINADI (kitobdagi namunadan):
     a  suddenly
     b  sleepily

  MA'NO JIHATDAN MAJBUR (boshqa variant mos kelmaydi):
     e  tightly      — 'closed the door TIGHTLY'
                       (boshqa ravish eshikka mos kelmaydi)
     f  desperately  — 'shouted DESPERATELY'
                       (77-betdagi hikoyada ham shunday)

  AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI:
     c, d, g, h — qolgan to'rt ravish (nervously,
     immediately, quickly, carefully) qaysi bo'shliqqa
     tushishini FAQAT audio hal qiladi.
     Quyida hikoya mantig'iga eng mos variant berilgan.


TO'LIQ HIKOYA (eng mos o'qilish bilan):

  a  Tony SUDDENLY heard noises.
  b  He went SLEEPILY to the window.
  c  He ran NERVOUSLY downstairs.
  d  He IMMEDIATELY rushed upstairs.
  e  He closed the door TIGHTLY.
  f  "Help!" he shouted DESPERATELY.
  g  He climbed QUICKLY onto a ladder.
  h  He climbed CAREFULLY down.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Toni to'satdan shovqin eshitdi. U uyqusirab deraza
  oldiga bordi. Asabiy holda pastga yugurdi. Darhol
  yuqoriga otildi. Eshikni mahkam yopdi. "Yordam bering!"
  — deb jon holatda qichqirdi. Tez narvonga chiqdi.
  Ehtiyotkorlik bilan pastga tushdi.


SO'NG VOQEALARNI BOG'LANG:
  first, next, after that, then, finally so'zlari bilan.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tony suddenly heard noises. FIRST, he went sleepily to
   the window. NEXT, ...'

TO'LIQ BOG'LANGAN VARIANT:
  Tony suddenly heard noises. First, he went sleepily to
  the window. Next, he ran nervously downstairs. After
  that, he immediately rushed upstairs and closed the door
  tightly. Then, "Help!" he shouted desperately. Finally,
  he climbed quickly onto a ladder and climbed carefully
  down.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a noise      = shovqin
  downstairs   = pastga (zinadan)
  upstairs     = yuqoriga (zinadan)
  to rush      = otilmoq, shoshilmoq
  to climb     = chiqmoq, tirmashmoq
  a ladder     = narvon
  sleepily     = uyqusirab
  nervously    = asabiy holda

items.whyUz:
ANIQ — kitobdagi namuna gapida yozilgan:
'Tony SUDDENLY heard noises.'
'suddenly' = to'satdan — hikoyaning burilish nuqtasi.

items.textEn: b  He went ............ to the window.
items.whyUz:
ANIQ — kitobdagi namuna gapida yozilgan:
'he went SLEEPILY to the window.'
'sleepily' = uyqusirab — u uyqudan uyg'ondi.
'sleepy' + -ly → ravish (79-betdagi qoida).

items.hintUz: Shovqin eshitgan odam qanday his qiladi?
items.whyUz:
AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: shovqin eshitib pastga yuguryapti —
hali nima bo'lganini bilmaydi, xavotirda →
NERVOUSLY (asabiy holda).
'nervous' + -ly → ravish.

AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: 'rush' (otilmoq) allaqachon tezlikni bildiradi,
shuning uchun 'quickly' takror bo'lardi.
'IMMEDIATELY rushed' = darhol otildi — tabiiy birikma.
DIQQAT: ravish bu yerda fe'ldan OLDIN turibdi.

MA'NO JIHATDAN MAJBUR — boshqa ravish eshikka mos
kelmaydi.
'closed the door TIGHTLY' = eshikni mahkam yopdi
(tutun kirmasligi uchun).
77-betdagi hikoyada ham: 'closed the car windows TIGHTLY'.

items.hintUz: Yordam so'rab qichqirgan odam qanday qichqiradi?
items.whyUz:
MA'NO JIHATDAN MAJBUR.
'shouted DESPERATELY' = jon holatda qichqirdi.
77-betdagi hikoyada ham: 'Claire screamed DESPERATELY'.
'desperate' + -ly → ravish.

items.textEn: g  He climbed ............ onto a ladder.
items.whyUz:
AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: uy yonyapti — narvonga TEZ chiqish kerak.
'a ladder' = narvon.
'climb ONTO' = ustiga chiqmoq.

AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI — bu yerda eng mos variant.
Asos: narvondan tushish XAVFLI, shuning uchun
EHTIYOTKORLIK bilan.
'careful' + -ly → carefully (78-betdagi namuna).
g-band bilan JUFT: tez chiqdi, ehtiyot bilan tushdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Now, link the events using first, next, after that, then and finally.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi voqealarni first, next, after that, then va finally so'zlari bilan bog'lang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Tony suddenly heard noises. FIRST, he went sleepily to
  the window. NEXT, ...

BESH BOG'LOVCHI SO'Z (77-betdagi qoidadan):
  first      — birinchi
  next       — keyin
  after that — shundan keyin
  then       — so'ng
  finally    — nihoyat

TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

  Tony suddenly heard noises. First, he went sleepily to
  the window. Next, he ran nervously downstairs. After
  that, he immediately rushed upstairs and closed the door
  tightly. Then, "Help!" he shouted desperately. Finally,
  he climbed quickly onto a ladder and climbed carefully
  down.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Toni to'satdan shovqin eshitdi. Avval u uyqusirab deraza
  oldiga bordi. Keyin asabiy holda pastga yugurdi. Shundan
  keyin darhol yuqoriga otildi va eshikni mahkam yopdi.
  So'ng "Yordam bering!" — deb jon holatda qichqirdi.
  Nihoyat, tez narvonga chiqdi va ehtiyotkorlik bilan
  pastga tushdi.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  Bu so'zlar gap boshida kelganda keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi.

structure.heading: FIRST
structure.modelEn: First, he went sleepily to the window.

structure.heading: AFTER THAT
structure.guideUz:
'After that,' + vergul.
Ikki harakatni 'and' bilan bog'lang.
structure.modelEn: After that, he immediately rushed upstairs and closed the door tightly.

structure.heading: FINALLY
structure.guideUz:
'Finally,' + vergul.
Oxirgi ikki harakatni 'and' bilan bog'lang.
structure.modelEn: Finally, he climbed quickly onto a ladder and climbed carefully down.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — TO'LIQ HIKOYA TUZILISHI:

  Hikoya yozganimizda voqea QAChON va QAYERDA sodir
  bo'lganini, hikoyadagi odamlar KIM ekanini va avval NIMA
  bo'lganini aytish bilan BOShLAYMIZ.

  So'ng ASOSIY VOQEADAN OLDIN nima bo'lganini yozib DAVOM
  ETTIRAMIZ (2-xatboshi), keyin hikoyaning ASOSIY
  VOQEASINI tasvirlaymiz (3-xatboshi).

  Hikoyani OXIRIDA nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini QANDAY
  HIS QILGANINI yozib TUGATAMIZ.

  Hikoya aytganimizda O'TGAN ZAMONLARNI ishlatamiz.


TO'RT XATBOSHI — REJA:

  1-XATBOShI: hikoyani BOShLASh
     • odamlar kim edi (WHO)
     • qachon / qayerda / nima bo'ldi (WHEN/WHERE/WHAT)

  2-3-XATBOShI: hikoyani RIVOJLANTIRISh
     • asosiy voqeadan OLDIN nima bo'ldi
     • ASOSIY VOQEANING o'zi

  4-XATBOShI: hikoyani TUGATISh
     • oxirida nima bo'ldi
     • u o'zini qanday his qildi


79-BETDAGI QOIDA BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  79-betda faqat BOShLANISh va TUGALLANMA berilgan edi.
  Bu yerda O'RTA qism (2-3-xatboshi) ham qo'shilgan —
  demak bu TO'LIQ tuzilish.


HIKOYADA ISHLATILADIGAN VOSITALAR (11-unitdan):
  • O'TGAN ZAMON             — was, went, saw, heard
  • SIFATLAR (78-bet)        — gorgeous, scary, brave
  • RAVIShLAR (79-bet)       — suddenly, desperately
  • KETMA-KETLIK (77-bet)    — first, then, finally
  • BOG'LOVChILAR (79-bet)   — and, but, because, so, when
  • HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI (78-bet) — into, through, over

points.en: When we write a story, we start by saying when and where the event happened, who the people in the story were and what happened first.
points.uz: Hikoya yozganimizda voqea qachon va qayerda sodir bo'lganini, odamlar kim ekanini va avval nima bo'lganini aytish bilan boshlaymiz.
points.noteUz:
1-XATBOShI.
79-betdagi 'When we start a story' qutisi bilan bir xil.

points.en: We continue with what happened just before the main event (2nd paragraph).
points.uz: Asosiy voqeadan oldin nima bo'lganini yozib davom ettiramiz (2-xatboshi).

points.en: ... then describe the main event of the story (3rd paragraph).
points.noteUz:
3-XATBOShI.
'the main event' = asosiy voqea —
77-betdagi 4-mashqning 7-savoli ham shu haqda edi.

points.en: We end our story by writing what finally happened and how the people in the story felt.
points.uz: Hikoyani oxirida nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini yozib tugatamiz.
points.noteUz:
4-XATBOShI.
79-betdagi 'When we end a story' qutisi bilan bir xil.

points.en: When we tell a story we use past tenses.
points.noteUz:
Past simple: was, went, heard, shouted.
Hozirgi zamon ISHLATILMAYDI (to'g'ri nutqdan tashqari).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures below and the events from Ex. 21 to write a story (100 - 150 words) for a magazine. End your story with ... After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlardan va 21-mashqdagi voqealardan foydalanib jurnal uchun hikoya (100-150 so'z) yozing. Hikoyangizni shu bilan tugating: ... After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI RASM:
  1-rasm — Uy yonmoqda. Derazadagi odam 'Help!' deb
           qichqiryapti. O't o'chiruvchi shlang bilan
           suv sepyapti.
  2-rasm — O't o'chiruvchi narvonda: 'Don't panic!
           I'll help you.' Odam narvondan tushyapti.

KITOB BERGAN TUGASH GAPI:
  ... After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
  ('After all' = axir, oxir-oqibat)


REJA (kitobdagi):
  Para 1:  hikoyani boshlash
           (odamlar kim edi, qachon/qayerda/nima bo'ldi)
     ↓
  Para 2-3: hikoyani rivojlantirish
           (asosiy voqeadan oldin nima bo'ldi / asosiy voqea)
     ↓
  Para 4:  hikoyani tugatish
           (oxirida nima bo'ldi — u qanday his qildi)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA HIKOYA (130 so'z):

  One cold winter night, Tony was asleep in his house in
  London. Suddenly, he heard noises. First, he went
  sleepily to the window, but he couldn't see anything.
  Next, he ran nervously downstairs.

  When he got to the kitchen, he saw smoke and flames
  everywhere. The house was on fire! He immediately rushed
  upstairs to his bedroom and closed the door tightly, so
  the smoke could not come in.

  Tony opened the window. "Help!" he shouted desperately. A
  few minutes later, a fire engine arrived and a
  firefighter put a ladder against the wall. "Don't panic!
  I'll help you," he shouted. Tony climbed quickly onto the
  ladder and then climbed carefully down.

  In the end, the firefighters put out the fire. Tony was
  shocked and very tired, but he felt safe. After all, he
  was very lucky to be alive!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Bir sovuq qish kechasi Toni Londondagi uyida uxlab
  yotgan edi. To'satdan u shovqin eshitdi. Avval uyqusirab
  deraza oldiga bordi, lekin hech narsa ko'ra olmadi.
  Keyin asabiy holda pastga yugurdi.

  Oshxonaga yetganida hamma yerda tutun va olovni ko'rdi.
  Uy yonayotgan edi! U darhol yuqoriga, yotoqxonasiga
  otildi va eshikni mahkam yopdi — tutun kirmasligi uchun.

  Toni derazani ochdi. "Yordam bering!" — deb jon holatda
  qichqirdi. Bir necha daqiqadan keyin o't o'chirish
  mashinasi keldi va o't o'chiruvchi devorga narvon qo'ydi.
  "Vahima qilmang! Men sizga yordam beraman," — deb
  qichqirdi u. Toni tez narvonga chiqdi va ehtiyotkorlik
  bilan pastga tushdi.

  Oxir-oqibat o't o'chiruvchilar yong'inni o'chirishdi.
  Toni sarosimada va juda charchagan edi, lekin o'zini
  xavfsiz his qildi. Axir, u tirik qolgani uchun juda
  omadli edi!


DIQQAT — SO'Z SONI:
  Kitob 100-150 so'z so'raydi.
  Yuqoridagi namuna — 130 so'z.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a flame        = alanga
  a firefighter  = o't o'chiruvchi
  a ladder       = narvon
  to put a ladder against = narvon qo'ymoq
  Don't panic!   = Vahima qilmang!
  to put out a fire = yong'inni o'chirmoq
  After all      = axir, oxir-oqibat

structure.heading: Para 1 — hikoyani boshlash
structure.guideUz:
Vaqt va joyni ayting, qahramonni tanishtiring,
birinchi voqeani yozing.
SIFATLAR qo'shing (78-bet).
'first' va 'next' bilan bog'lang.
structure.modelEn: One cold winter night, Tony was asleep in his house in London. Suddenly, he heard noises. First, he went sleepily to the window, but he couldn't see anything. Next, he ran nervously downstairs.

structure.heading: Para 2 — asosiy voqeadan oldin
structure.guideUz:
Xavfni ochib bering.
'when' bilan vaqt gapini bog'lang (79-bet).
'so' bilan natijani ko'rsating.
structure.modelEn: When he got to the kitchen, he saw smoke and flames everywhere. The house was on fire! He immediately rushed upstairs to his bedroom and closed the door tightly, so the smoke could not come in.

structure.heading: Para 3 — asosiy voqea
structure.guideUz:
Eng keskin nuqta.
TO'G'RI NUTQ qo'shing — hikoyani jonli qiladi.
'a few minutes later' bilan vaqt o'tishini ko'rsating.
structure.modelEn: Tony opened the window. "Help!" he shouted desperately. A few minutes later, a fire engine arrived and a firefighter put a ladder against the wall. "Don't panic! I'll help you," he shouted. Tony climbed quickly onto the ladder and then climbed carefully down.

structure.heading: Para 4 — hikoyani tugatish
structure.headingUz: 4-xatboshi: oxirida nima bo'ldi va qanday his qildi
structure.guideUz:
'In the end' bilan boshlang.
HIS-TUYG'U sifatlarini ishlating (79-bet).
Kitob bergan gap bilan TUGATING.
structure.modelEn: In the end, the firefighters put out the fire. Tony was shocked and very tired, but he felt safe. After all, he was very lucky to be alive!

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nima ma'noni bildiradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkala maqol ham 11-unitning mavzusi bilan bog'liq:
  hikoya, natija va tasvir.

sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: yo'lda qanchalik qiyinchilik bo'lsa ham,
agar NATIJA yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi joyida hisoblanadi.

BU — UNITNING NOMI.
Shekspirning pyesa nomi, ingliz maqoliga aylangan.

UNIT MISOLLARI:
  Kler va Greg — mashina yondi, sherlar o'rab oldi,
     lekin qutulishdi → hammasi yaxshi tugadi.
  Hans Brinker — tun bo'yi sovuqda turdi,
     lekin Gollandiyani qutqardi → hammasi yaxshi tugadi.
  Toni — uyi yondi, lekin tirik qoldi
     → hammasi yaxshi tugadi.

GRAMMATIKA:
  'All's' = 'All IS' ning qisqartmasi.
  'that' bu yerda ergash gap boshlaydi.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Yaxshi tugaydigan hamma narsa yaxshidir.'

O'ZBEKCHA MOSI:
  'Oxiri xayrli bo'lsin'
  'Yaxshi tugagan ish — yaxshi ish'

sentences.en: A picture is worth a thousand words.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: bitta rasm uzoq tushuntirishdan ko'ra ko'proq
narsani ko'rsatadi. Ko'rish — eshitishdan kuchliroq.

UNIT BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  11-unitda hikoyalar RASMLAR orqali beriladi:
     76-bet — 6 rasm (safari park)
     78-bet — 9 rasm (Ralf ot minadi)
     80-bet — 4 rasm (Hans Brinker)
     81-bet — 2 rasm (Toni va yong'in)
  Har safar rasmlarga qarab hikoya tuziladi —
  chunki rasm ming so'zga arziydi.

GRAMMATIKA:
  'to be worth something' = ...ga arzimoq.
  'a thousand' = ming (artikl 'a' bilan).

O'ZBEKCHA MOSI:
  'Bir ko'rgan — ming eshitgandan afzal'
  'Ko'z ko'rgani — quloq eshitganidan ishonchli'

groups.explanationUz: Hammasi SIFAT + LY qoidasi bilan yasalgan.

items.base: It was an experience I will never forget.
items.baseUz: Bu — men hech qachon unutmaydigan tajriba edi.

patterns.formula: I WANT TO REPORT + muammo + AT my house.
patterns.exampleEn: I want to report a break-in at my house. Please come quickly!
patterns.exampleUz: Uyimga o'g'rilik bo'lgani haqida xabar bermoqchiman. Iltimos, tezroq keling!
patterns.explanationUz:
Favqulodda xizmatga muammoni bildirish qolipi.
'report a fire / an accident / a break-in'.

patterns.formula: COULD YOU give me your + ma'lumot + , PLEASE?
patterns.exampleEn: Could you give me your address and telephone number, please?
patterns.exampleUz: Manzilingiz va telefon raqamingizni ayta olasizmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'Could you ...?' — 'Can you' dan MULOYIMROQ.
Rasmiy suhbatda ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: There's A + transport + ON THE WAY now.
patterns.exampleEn: There's a police car on the way now.
patterns.explanationUz:
'on the way' = yo'lda, kelayotgan.
Operatorning tinchlantiruvchi javobi.

patterns.formula: Ega + RAVISH + FE'L.   /   Ega + FE'L + RAVISH.
patterns.exampleEn: Tony suddenly heard noises. He shouted desperately.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni to'satdan shovqin eshitdi. U jon holatda qichqirdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ravish fe'ldan OLDIN ham, KEYIN ham kelishi mumkin.
'suddenly' odatda oldin, tarz ravishlari odatda keyin.

patterns.formula: FIRST, ... NEXT, ... AFTER THAT, ... THEN, ... FINALLY, ...
patterns.exampleEn: First, he went sleepily to the window. Next, he ran nervously downstairs.
patterns.exampleUz: Avval u uyqusirab deraza oldiga bordi. Keyin asabiy holda pastga yugurdi.

patterns.formula: AFTER ALL, he was very LUCKY TO BE alive!
patterns.exampleEn: After all, he was very lucky to be alive!
patterns.exampleUz: Axir, u tirik qolgani uchun juda omadli edi!
patterns.explanationUz:
Kitob bergan TUGASH gapi.
'After all' = axir, oxir-oqibat.
'lucky TO BE alive' — 77-betda ham bor edi.
